archive_baseline.scope: sha256 of every episode.json and episode_complete.json in the archive, folded into one aggregate digest
archive_baseline.meaning: a change-detection reference captured before the platform read path went live; it is not a claim that the archive contents are training-qualified or independently verified

source.path_boundary: every derived path is re-resolved and must stay inside the declared root and, for episode contents, inside that episode's resolved directory; the run directory must additionally resolve to itself

identity.run_directory_identity: the run directory was re-validated as itself before this read

anchor.semantics: one persisted image frame per record, carrying the recorder's own capture and persist clocks

paging.offset_semantics: next_offset is the raw line index after the last returned anchor in the anchor file; the following request re-tests every line at or above it against the same eligibility rules

scan.note: a full page stops at the first further qualifying anchor, so the counts above describe the lines actually read and are not a whole-file census

fields_that_name_a_shared_base: persisted frame clock and capture_clocks, transform row clock_id, state event backend_monotonic_s, timing payload feedback_clock
on the representative frame all of them name backend_monotonic
clock_sameness.verified_claim: naming one clock base is not proof that two writers stamped it at one instant

recorded: run manifest contract_version and software name/version
observation profile_id, profile_version and profile_sha256 on the persisted frame
not_recorded: the native build or release that wrote the archive
a source commit for the writer
writer_version_binding.consequence: current native source can describe how these fields are produced, but cannot be cited as proof that this archive's writer behaved identically

image_observation.meaning: the rgb and depth observation rows recorded for this frame, each with its own media uri

requirement.rule: one row per required sensor_kind, matched by the row's own sensor_kind field

camera_transform.meaning: camera extrinsics recorded for this frame; not a per-body pose sequence

requirement.rule: exactly one transform row for this sample_id

capture_timing_event.meaning: the recorder's own capture-timing event for this frame

requirement.rule: exactly one rgbd_capture_timing event naming this sample_id

state_feedback_event.meaning: recorded robot state feedback carried on the frame's capture tick

requirement.rule: exactly one state event carrying this control_tick_id

feedback_observation_row.meaning: an observation row whose own sample_id equals the frame's declared feedback_sample_id

requirement.rule: exactly one observation row whose sample_id equals the declared feedback id

recorded_target_event.meaning: the recorded actuator reference (Target) carried on the frame's capture tick; a target is not an achieved state

requirement.rule: reported only for records that really carry the frame's control_tick_id; absence stays absence and is never filled from a neighbouring tick

command_dispatch_event.meaning: the command record the recorder marked as dispatched on the frame's capture tick; sparse, and absent for most frames by measurement

requirement.rule: reported only for records that really carry the frame's control_tick_id; a dispatched command is not evidence that the frame or the state reached it

status_meaning.matched: every record the role requires was found by its recorded key, once
status_meaning.partial: some but not all records the role requires were found
status_meaning.missing: no record for this role carried the key
status_meaning.unresolved_reference: the frame declares a reference whose target record is not in this Episode
status_meaning.identity_mismatch: a candidate record named a different run or Episode and was excluded
status_meaning.stream_absent: the source stream is not recorded in this Episode
status_meaning.ambiguous_kind: a sensor_kind the role requires was recorded more than once for the same frame key
status_meaning.ambiguous_candidates: more than one record claimed this role's key, so no single record can be reported

selection_rules.joins: exact equality of the recorded join key named on each role; never a filename, line order or browser arrival order
selection_rules.when_nothing_matches: the role is reported as missing, unresolved_reference or stream_absent, with the key that was looked for
selection_rules.when_several_match: ambiguous_kind or ambiguous_candidates with every candidate line index listed; the first line in the file is not chosen
selection_rules.completeness: judged by the required sensor_kind set and per-kind cardinality, never by a record count alone
selection_rules.state_hold: not applied: a frame never inherits another frame's state
selection_rules.nearest_in_time: not used; numeric closeness is not treated as identity or as simultaneity

changed: paging.has_more is decided by finding the next qualifying anchor line rather than by comparing a prefiltered record count with a raw file line index
paging reports which lines were actually read, and blank, oversize, unparseable and non-object lines separately from records examined
role completeness is judged by the required sensor_kind set and per-kind cardinality; repeated candidates are ambiguous_kind or ambiguous_candidates instead of a silent first-wins match
times.quantities names each recorded difference by record, field, unit and meaning, and times.recorder_declared copies the recorder's own latency fields
time.clock_sameness separates the fields that name a shared clock base from what the reader can verify, and states how far the record's writing version can be bound

removed_fields.times.age_of_state_relative_to_frame: it merged the state event's write stamp with the state sample stamps; read times.quantities keys state_event_write_minus_frame_capture, state_payload_feedback_time_minus_frame_capture and recorder_declared_feedback_time_minus_frame_capture instead

corrections: state_sim_time_minus_frame_capture_sim_time now names only the state feedback PAYLOAD stamp and is absent when the payload carries no numeric sim_time_s; earlier builds of this version silently filled it from the event envelope while still labelling the payload as the source
the envelope's own simulator time is a separate quantity, state_event_envelope_sim_time_minus_frame_capture_sim_time
no quantity is ever filled from another record: absence is reported as absence

time_quality.coverage.covers_whole_episode now requires both that the scan reached end of file and that every line of the anchor file was decided; an earlier build of this version reported it from EOF alone, so a file holding an unparsable or oversized line could still earn whole-episode scheduling on the strength of the anchors that happened to be readable
time_quality.coverage.scope_note no longer calls a windowed page a reduced census: the page filter narrows the frames returned, while the census scans this Episode's anchor file on its own terms
additions: time_quality.coverage.line_accounting separates benign lines from undecidable ones and names the positions of the undecided ones, so a coverage statement can be checked against the file it describes
each time base is now reported on three separate questions: reached_end_of_file, every_line_of_the_anchor_file_is_decided, readable_anchor_timing_satisfies_schedule

action_basis (opt-in) is the measured event vocabulary of one Episode, the join keys each type really carries, and per-frame association by recorded key — it adds no new endpoint and no server-side session
version_migration.compatibility_note: consumers must read schema_version: frame-link-1 and frame-link-2 pages are not the same contract

blank_lines_skipped.why: an empty line carries no record at all, so nothing about it is unknown

prefiltered_lines_skipped.why: raw text that cannot contain the requested stream_id token is not an anchor record of the requested stream under the reader's own documented prefilter rule

oversize_lines_skipped.why: the content was never parsed, so it cannot be ruled out as an anchor record

unparseable_lines_skipped.why: a truncated or half-written line is exactly how a lost anchor would look

non_object_lines_skipped.why: valid JSON that is not an object is not a conforming record, and what it was meant to carry is unknown

line_accounting.note: a blank line and a line that cannot carry the requested stream token are decided, not corruption; a line the reader could not parse is undecided and could have carried an anchor, so it blocks a whole-episode claim

coverage.scope_note: the census scans this Episode's anchor file itself; a time window or page filter narrows the frame page, not the census, so whole-episode support depends only on this scan reaching EOF with every line decided — a scan that stopped at the anchor limit or met undecidable content supports no whole-episode or whole-archive claim

page_filter_context.note: the census covers the anchors this Episode exposes in file order, not only the rows of this page

capture_backend_monotonic_s.description: seconds, native backend monotonic clock at capture

persist_backend_monotonic_s.description: seconds, native backend monotonic clock at persist

identity.effect_on_this_route: a duplicated id makes `sample_id=` address more than one anchor, so the page cannot name one position for it
identity.effect_on_robot_state: GET /api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/robot-state?sample_id= refuses with frame_sample_id_ambiguous instead of taking the first match

profile.note: the anchors carry a profile identifier, not a declared numeric rate; no rate is inferred from the profile name

modes.append_order_display: A: show anchors in the recorder's own append order of the anchor file
modes.recorded_interval_schedule: B: schedule a step by the recorded gap on one named capture base
modes.cross_stream_synchronized: C: play several streams against one verified shared instant

append_order_display.basis: the anchor file is read in the recorder's own append order and a full page stops at the first further qualifying anchor
append_order_display.gap_note: A stays available: undecidable lines are reported with their positions so the reader can show what it could not decide, but they are not silently presented as a complete frame sequence

capture_backend_monotonic_s.implied_rate_note: derived from the recorded values of this scan; it is not a rate the recorder declared and it is not a playback guarantee

capture_sim_time_s.implied_rate_note: derived from the recorded values of this scan; it is not a rate the recorder declared and it is not a playback guarantee

persist_backend_monotonic_s.implied_rate_note: derived from the recorded values of this scan; it is not a rate the recorder declared and it is not a playback guarantee

rules_when_unqualified.missing_or_non_numeric_time: the base is refused for scheduling; the frame stays visible in append order and no value is filled from another record
rules_when_unqualified.equal_adjacent_values: ties are shown as ties; they are not interpolated and a rate is not computed by dividing by zero
rules_when_unqualified.backwards_step: the base is refused for scheduling over that range, because one continuous clock across the step is not established by the record
rules_when_unqualified.clock_unknown: a base that only names a clock is not evidence of a shared clock source
rules_when_unqualified.undecidable_or_truncated_scan: no whole-episode schedule is claimed: undecided content could hide an anchor, so the clean timing of the readable anchors cannot prove the rest of the Episode

never_assumed.why: no record establishes a nominal rate, a host clock relationship across segments, or a RESET boundary on these anchors

cross_stream_synchronized.reason: the records name shared clock bases but nothing lets this reader verify one shared clock source or one sampled instant across streams

not_proven: coverage beyond the anchors scanned here
RESET or segment boundaries on anchors
that undecided anchor-file lines carry no frame record, when such lines exist

scope.scope_note: the vocabulary covers every record the scan read in this Episode's events stream; a scan that stopped at the record limit describes only what it read

recorded_state_initial.meaning: the state snapshot the recorder took when the segment started

actual_state_feedback.meaning: recorded robot state as measured (Actual); never promoted to a live read

recorded_target.meaning: recorded actuator reference (Target); a target is not an achieved state

command_intent.meaning: a command the recorder saw requested; intent only, no execution claim

command_receipt_accepted.meaning: a recorded approval decision beside the request

command_receipt_rejected.meaning: a recorded rejection; its absence is not evidence that nothing was rejected
command_receipt_rejected.status_note: the scan found no record of this category; that is a fact about this Episode's events stream, not a claim that the recorder can never write one

command_dispatched.meaning: a command the recorder marked as dispatched

capture_timing.meaning: the recorder's own per-frame capture timing event

lease_boundary.meaning: lease renewal and expiry records naming a session; they are not a takeover protocol

episode_lifecycle.meaning: segment start, stop request and terminal declaration

frame_association.key: control_tick_id equals the frame anchor's own capture_control_tick_id

dispatch.reason: no record of this type names this capture tick

feedback_initial.reason: no record of this type names this capture tick

rules.association: exact equality of the recorded key; a frame's capture tick matched against the record's control_tick_id
rules.no_shared_key: the category is reported as an independent event track, readable by event_seq and named time bases only
rules.when_several_match: ambiguous_candidates with every candidate position listed; the first line in the file is not chosen
rules.when_nothing_matches: missing, with the key that was looked for — no carry-over from the previous tick, no nearest-in-time
rules.rejected_requests: a rejected or unapproved request is never presented as an executed action
rules.operator_source: the source is whatever the record's own operator fields name; it is never defaulted to Human
rules.zero_action: no action vector is invented for a tick that records none
rules.units: taken from the recorder's own field-name suffix; a field without a unit-bearing suffix is reported as unknown_from_field_name

command_chain.note: a request, its approval and its dispatch are separate records joined by command_id; the chain proves no execution result, and a rejected request never becomes an executed action

control_source.note: the recorder names an operator inside some payloads and a lease beside its own session id; it records no control-source switch or takeover event in this scan, and the reader never defaults a source to Human

action_basis.independent_track_reason: these categories share no key with a frame anchor in this scan, so they are read as their own track by event_seq or a named time base, never attached to the nearest frame or the previous record
not_proven: that any command below was physically executed
that an absent category is impossible for the recorder
that a scanned event and a frame share one clock instant
